skill.name: visdenda-agent
skill.description: Analyze traffic declines, low click-through rates, indexing gaps, and AI crawler access using Visdenda, Google Search Console, and crawl evidence. Prioritize fixes and verify technical changes with a scoped Visdenda API key.
skill.summary: Diagnose SEO issues with search and crawl evidence, then prioritize and verify fixes.
skill.author: visdenda

security_audit.summary: The 50 static matches are documentation or routine SEO guidance, not evidence of shell execution, credential harvesting, or unauthorized reconnaissance. No evidence was found of a direct prompt injection attempt. The workflow still needs safeguards for artifact sharing, live references, and follow-up actions suggested by tool results.

remediation.issue: Artifact sharing lacks recipient and data checks.
remediation.suggestion: Require authenticated, site-scoped artifact access. Confirm the recipient and data scope before sharing, and provide a redacted summary when access cannot be verified.

remediation.issue: Tool responses can select follow-up tools.
remediation.suggestion: Treat returned action names as suggestions. Check them against an allowlist and the user's authorized site and task. Keep confirmation requirements for writes and paid calls.

remediation.issue: Live references can change after review.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer bundled references by relative path. Pin and verify any remote guidance used for decisions, and do not treat retrieved instructions as executable directions.

semantic_findings.title: Report sharing lacks a recipient check
semantic_findings.description: The workflow directs the agent to share 30-day artifact links containing the tool payload without checking the recipient or report sensitivity. The links may expose scoped site evidence if they are accessible without equivalent authorization.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The sharing instruction and payload are explicit. The reviewed text does not establish whether artifact pages require site-scoped authorization.

semantic_findings.title: Tool results can steer follow-up actions
semantic_findings.description: The workflow directs the agent to select follow-up tools using action and verification fields from service responses. It does not require checking those suggestions against an approved tool list and the user's authorized task.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The action selection is explicit, and write confirmation mitigates some risk. There is no evidence that an attacker currently controls these fields.

semantic_findings.title: Live guidance is not pinned to the reviewed revision
semantic_findings.description: The workflow points agents to live vendor references for task guidance instead of using the bundled copies. Edits or compromise upstream could change the instructions agents follow without changing the reviewed package.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The links point to live paths with no version or integrity check. No evidence was found that the linked content is malicious.

content.value_statement: Search and crawl data can show where a site is struggling without making the next step clear. Visdenda combines that evidence to rank issues, explain gaps, and verify technical fixes.
actual_capabilities: Compare Search Console time windows to find declining pages, low click-through queries, and queries where multiple pages compete.
Rank technical findings from a completed audit and identify the evidence behind each failing rule.
Distinguish known indexing exclusions from unknown status and inspect canonical tags and crawl evidence for a selected page.
Summarize observed AI crawler access, referrals, and sampled AI Overview presence when the relevant data is available.
Compare tracked competitor page changes and identify topics that the owned site does not cover.
Record a proposed fix for review and verify the technical rule after a separately applied change.
limitations: Requires a scoped Visdenda API key and an authorized site. MCP access also requires a client that supports Streamable HTTP.
Live Search Console reads require a paid plan and available quota. Archived data is monthly, and final Search Console data typically lags about three days.
AI crawler observations require probe data, and sampled AI Overview results cannot establish site-wide visibility.
The proposal tool does not edit the site. A passing technical check does not prove that traffic or rankings improved.

use_cases.title: Investigate an organic traffic decline
use_cases.description: Compare equal Search Console windows, identify the pages losing clicks, and separate observed changes from possible causes.

use_cases.title: Prioritize a template fix
use_cases.description: Find a rule failing across several pages, review its evidence, and plan a recheck after an approved template change.

use_cases.title: Review AI crawler coverage
use_cases.description: See which crawlers reached the site, which paths were blocked, and what probe or search data was unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Find the top SEO issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review an authorized site's current findings.
prompt_templates.prompt: For [site], show me the most important SEO issue and the evidence behind it. Tell me what was not evaluated. Keep this review read-only.

prompt_templates.title: Explain an indexing result
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Investigate a single URL before changing it.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the available index verdict for [page URL] on [site]. Distinguish exclusion from unknown status using crawl and canonical evidence. Recommend one next check without changing the site.

prompt_templates.title: Compare traffic over time
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Investigate declines without assuming a cause.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the latest available 28 days of Search Console data for [site] with the preceding 28 days. List the top declining pages, the source, and the data cutoff. If live data is unavailable, explain what archived monthly data can show instead.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and verify a template fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Prepare a change for approval and a separate verification pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [finding] for [site] and identify the affected template and pages. Draft the smallest fix with its evidence and a verification plan. Wait for my confirmation before recording a proposal. After I apply the change, ask before updating any finding state.

output_examples.input: Why did clicks decline on the pricing page?
output_examples.output: Clicks fell from 480 to 360 across two equal 28-day Search Console windows. The decline coincided with lower average position, but the data does not establish a cause. Check which queries lost position before changing the page.

output_examples.input: Is the guide missing from Google's index?
output_examples.output: Index status is unknown because no verdict was returned. The latest crawl found a canonical tag pointing to a different URL. Confirm the intended canonical and obtain an index verdict before changing the page.

The affected pages now pass the breadcrumb rule that failed in the previous audit. This verifies the markup fix, not a traffic gain. Compare equal Search Console windows once enough data is available.

best_practices: Use a site-scoped key with only the permissions required for the approved task.
Record the source, date range, and evidence for each finding. Mark unavailable data separately from zero.
Confirm writes and paid research in advance. Share reports only with authorized recipients.
anti_patterns: Do not treat unknown index status or missing probe data as evidence of a problem or as zero activity.
Do not attribute traffic changes to a search update or a fix without evidence that supports the conclusion.
Do not retry beyond quotas, run unapproved paid research, or change a site without confirmation.

faq.question: What do I need to connect Visdenda?
faq.answer: Use an admin-issued Visdenda API key with the appropriate scopes. For MCP, use a client that supports Streamable HTTP and bearer authentication.

faq.question: Can I analyze a site without live Search Console access?
faq.answer: Yes, when other authorized sources are available. Use archived monthly Search Console data if present, and report which metrics could not be evaluated.

faq.question: Does the skill edit my site automatically?
faq.answer: No. The Visdenda proposal tool records a change for human review and does not apply it. Writes require confirmation.

faq.question: Which research calls may cost money?
faq.answer: Live search results, keyword metrics, keyword research, and AI visibility checks can use paid providers. Review the estimate and approve it before the call.

faq.question: What does missing AI crawler data mean?
faq.answer: Without probe data, crawler activity cannot be determined. Missing data does not mean that no AI crawlers visited.

faq.question: Does verifying a fix prove traffic will recover?
faq.answer: No. Verification checks whether a technical rule now passes. Measure traffic separately using comparable Search Console windows.
